title: sporobolus angustus
intro: Sporobolus angustus, commonly known as saltgrass, is a type of perennial grass native to the Americas. It is known for its health benefits, particularly in the reduction of inflammation and improvement of respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sporobolus angustus include its use as a bronchodilator and anti-inflammatory agent, which may also help to lower blood sugar levels and improve wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Sporobolus angustus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
